summary: End-to-end verification of the header 'superpowers' phase: global 3-stroke nav menu, currency picker (USD/EUR/GBP/JPY/INR/CAD), language picker (EN/ES/FR/JA), search superpowers (voice mic, image camera, live counter, vibe hint chip), Command Palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K), Mini-cart hover flyout, Live sync badge with countdown, compact sticky-header behavior. Backend (pytest 3/3 pass): GET /api/currency/rates returns base=USD and all 6 currencies with USD=1.0; POST /api/search/image with tiny b64 returns {description, keywords, category, items, total} on 200 (accepts 500 fallback if LLM cannot classify). Frontend Playwright flow: home renders, global-nav-btn opens panel with Home/Browse/Cart/Favorites and login/register (logged-out), and adds Sell/Chat/Wallet/Disputes/Store/Analytics/Referrals/Affiliate/Verify/Profile/Admin (logged-in as admin). currency-picker-btn opens menu with all 6 options; selecting EUR flips prices site-wide to '€' symbol (verified on catalog cards). lang-picker-btn switching to ES changes Sell button to 'Vender' and body copy shows Vender/Ingresar/Categorías. Search bar shows header-search-voice (mic), header-search-image (camera) + hidden file input, header-search-btn, header-search-input, and search-vibe-hint on idle empty state. Mic click toggles pulsing red 'listening' style (class includes bg-red-500/pulse). Typing 'sneakers' shows search-live-count='50 matches' after debounce. header-cp-btn present; pressing Control+K opens data-testid=command-palette with command-palette-input auto-focused; typing 'nike' returns 6 cp-item-* rows; Escape closes. Mini-cart hover on header-cart-btn shows data-testid=mini-cart-flyout (both logged-out and logged-in states); logged-in empty cart renders empty state (items=0, no subtotal — expected). Live-sync-badge visible with live-sync-next countdown. Compact sticky: header height shrinks from 170px → 57px after scrolling ~600px and expands back to 170px on scroll-to-top. Category ribbon renders 22 pills (All + 21 categories). Login as admin (admin@mercari.local / admin123) succeeds and header-user-btn appears.
critical_code_review_comments: SearchAutocomplete voice search relies on window.SpeechRecognition — in Playwright headless the click was graceful (no crash) and the pulsing style toggled; consider a visible tooltip when the API is unavailable (browser-only feature).

POST /api/search/image raises 500 (HTTPException) on LLM JSON parse errors; consider returning a graceful empty payload {items:[], keywords:[], category:null, total:0} instead, matching /vibe's fallback pattern, so the frontend can render 'no matches' instead of an error.
NotificationsBell has no explicit data-testid on its trigger button — add data-testid='header-notif-btn' for testability.

GlobalNavMenu panel width (86% of screen) can push the close button off-screen at larger viewports when combined with body scroll-lock; a small fix would be max-width plus explicit right padding on the header row. Not blocking.

Mini-cart flyout renders even when cart is empty — good UX, but consider showing a clearer 'Your cart is empty' testid (data-testid='mini-cart-empty') to allow tests to assert the empty state deterministically.
Compact-sticky transition switches h-16 sm:h-20 → h-14 (16px difference on mobile) — feels subtle; the reduction is more noticeable on desktop (h-20 → h-14). Fine as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header 'superpowers' phase fully green. Data-testids to reuse: global-nav-btn, global-nav-panel, global-nav-close, gnav-* (home/search/cart/favorites/sell/chat/wallet/disputes/store/analytics/referrals/affiliate/verify/profile/admin/login/register), currency-picker-btn, currency-picker-menu, currency-option-{USD,EUR,GBP,JPY,INR,CAD}, lang-picker-btn, lang-picker-menu, lang-option-{en,es,fr,ja}, header-search-voice, header-search-image, header-search-image-input, header-search-btn, header-search-input, search-live-count, search-vibe-hint, header-cp-btn, command-palette, command-palette-input, cp-item-*, header-cart-btn, mini-cart-flyout, mini-cart-item-*, mini-cart-remove-*, mini-cart-subtotal, mini-cart-view-cart, mini-cart-checkout, live-sync-badge, live-sync-ago, live-sync-next. Login: use page.get_by_role('button', name='Log in') — the header search button also has type=submit so selectors like 'form button[type=submit]' are non-unique.
